property_summary: For any inputs, C.transfer always invokes the external function with selector transferFrom(address,address,uint256) (so a callee that implements transferFrom will be called and the overall call succeeds), whereas the mutant instead calls transfer(address,address,uint256) — so using a callee that only implements transferFrom will make the mutant fail while the reference succeeds.
change_summary: Change the selector to call transfer(address,address,uint256) instead of transferFrom, altering which external function is invoked and thus possibly changing returned success behavior.
